source_review: Buffer address alignment, SPIR-V stride/offset and spirv-val checked.
Two slot tables wait on slot fences before write/resize.
Existing upload barriers and deferred mesh/relight buffer retirement retained.
Unsupported hardware uses old drawing path; actual unsupported device not available.
not_exercised: Interactive movement, editing, resize, regeneration and fluid scenes.
Hardware maxDrawIndirectCount split and multiple near runs interleaved with LOD were not forced by a diagnostic override.

environment.mode: headless, fully loaded static flat world, two frame slots

decision.reason: CPU-bound radius32 improves; small GPU time cost explicitly accepted as an implementation tradeoff, not a GPU speedup.
decision.limitations: Initial pooled p95 worsened; last extended pair has larger variance. No completed run or outlier removed. No improvement claim for GPU-bound scenes.
